m: रात mfn. given, presented, bestowed, RV. &c. &c. (often ifc.; cf. अस्मद्-, देव-, ब्रह्म-र्˚. &c.)
रात m. N. of a teacher, Piṅg., Sch.
रात राति &c. See p. 871, col. 3.

a: रातंती — A festival on the fourteenth day of the second half of Pauṣa.

m: रात—हविस् (रात-), mfn. one who willingly presents offerings, a liberal offerer or worshipper (of the gods), RV.
रात—हव्य (रात-), mfn. id., ib.
one to whom the offering is presented, one who receives the oblation, ib.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
रात—हव्य m. (with आत्रेय) N. of the author of RV. v, 65; 66; Anukr.
रात—मनस् (रात-), mfn. ready-minded, willing to (dat.), ŚBr.
रातन्ती (?), a festival on the fourteenth day of the second half of the month Pauṣa (when people bathe at the first appearance of dawn), MW.
राति mfn. ready or willing to give, generous, favourable, gracious, RV.; AV.; VS.; Br.
राति f. a favour, grace, gift, oblation, RV. &c. &c. (in RV. also ‘the Giver’ conceived of as a deity and associated with Bhaga; इन्द्रस्य राती v.l. ˚तिः N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.)
a: राति — a. Ved. 1 Liberal, favourable, generous. --2 Ready. --तिः A friend (opp. to अरातिः). --f. 1 Giving, bestowing, presentation, --2 A favour. --3 A gift, present. --Comp. --साच् a. --(षाच्) bestowing gifts, liberal, bountiful.

m: राति-कुल n. a house (whose inhabitants are) disposed to give (alms), Hir.
रातिन् mfn. containing gifts or oblations (as a sacrificial ladle), RV.
राति—षाच् (for -साच्) mfn. granting favours, dispensing gifts, liberal, generous, RV.; AV.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
रात्न mf(ई)n. consisting of pearls, HPariś.

m: रात्री (= रात्रि), in comp.
रात्रीण See एक- and द्वि-र्˚.
a: रात्रीण — a. Lasting for a certain number of nights.

m: रात्री—दैवोदास n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr. (v.l. रात्रीहव-दैव्˚).
रात्री—करण mfn. turning into night, HPariś.
रात्री—सूक्त = रात्रि-स्˚, Cat.

रात्रौ ind., at n˚, by n˚; रात्रौ शयनम्, a festival on the 11th day of the first half of the month Āṣāḍha, regarded as the night of the gods, beginning with the summer solstice, when Viṣṇu reposes for four months on the serpent Śeṣa
रात्रौ-भव mfn. (fr. रात्रौ loc. of रात्रि + भव) happening or occurring at night, ĀpŚr., Sch.

m: रात्रक mf(इका)n. nocturnal, nightly, lasting a night, Rājat.; Pañcat. (cf. पञ्च-र्˚)
रात्रक m. a man who dwells for a whole year in a harlot's house, L.
रात्रक n. = पञ्च-रात्र N. of the sacred books of various Vaiṣṇava sects, L. (others ‘a period of 5 nights’ collectively).
a: रात्रक — a. Nocturnal, nightly. --कः A man who takes up his abode in a harlot's house for one year. --कं A period of five nights taken collectively (?).
